scope: The direct cut proof recovers the full private count sum(|S_i|-1) when fewer than k global wide outsiders remain. Also proves |private union|+k+|outsiders|<=size from the prefix minterm budget. Requires no proper-target condition or circuit normalization.
math_audit: Every cut-frontier wire outside the selected private class, outside the global outsider set, and different from z has at most one singleton positive in the selected target.
One singleton witness outside the target activates each global outsider by monotonicity. The union has size at most the number of outsiders and stays disjoint from the target.
If the private count were too small, a target singleton missed by all remaining frontier labels would transfer through the cut to that low-weight negative input.
Private gates, outside wide gates, empty-support prefix branches, and z are disjoint. This yields the strengthened gate budget.
Universal targets, arbitrary empty/singleton targets, constant gates, and malformed circuit references are covered by the semantic definitions.

prior_attempt.cause: The main cut theorem and budget passed; the summed corollary needed an explicit singleton-filter cardinality equality.
